cohort: Pregnant women and newborns in Poland during the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic.
finding: Polish guidelines initially recommended cesarean section for confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection, but later shifted to not considering infection as a primary indication, while advocating for breastfeeding even in infected mothers.
mod_finding: Polish guidelines initially recommended cesarean section for confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection, but later shifted to not considering infection as a primary indication for cesarean section.
